timed_text.text: Today: visualization. One of the highest-leverage tools in this program.
Mental imagery activates the same neural pathways as physical execution.
Your brain can't distinguish a vivid visualization from the real thing.
Every visualization rep is a real training rep.
I build custom visualization scripts for every athlete I coach one-on-one.
You need to see yourself succeeding before you can execute the process.
Sights, sounds, sensations — the more sensory detail, the more powerful.
Start with one breath — then close your eyes and build the scene.

cards.prompt: Close your eyes. Place yourself in your next competition. Build every detail of the environment.
What do you hear? The crowd, your teammates, the sounds specific to your sport.
Feel your body. What does it feel like to be moving well? What does that sensation feel like?
See the moment — the execution, the result. Watch yourself succeed. Hold it.
How does it feel when it happens? Stay there.

timed_text.text: Your brain just treated that as a real performance rep.
Build the image until it feels familiar.
Because when it's familiar, it's less threatening.
And when it's less threatening, you compete free.
Hit the journal and after you finish, day 22 is complete.

blocks.prompt: How vivid was the visualization? What detail made it feel most real — and what was hardest to hold?
